01  —  About Maica

Thirty years of colour, a studio of her own

Maica has been colouring hair for more than thirty years. Now she has opened her own small studio a few steps from Jávea Port, where every appointment is hers from start to finish.

She listens first, looks at your skin tone and the light you live in, then mixes a colour that is warm, luminous and easy to wear — and keeps your hair healthy while she does it.

02  —  Services

The art of warm colour

Every appointment starts with a quiet conversation about your hair, your routine and the result you are hoping for.

  1. 01

    Colour & highlights

    Warm, multi-tonal colour and soft highlights that catch the light — copper, caramel, honey and golden tones.

    Balayage

    A cut shaped to your hair type — straight, wavy or curly — and finished so it falls well at home too.
